{{Youmay|the [[Writing/Legends|writing system]]|''[[Asaari Wind]]'', a ship also called ''Hieroglyph''}}
'''Hieroglyphics''' was an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] term describing [[Alien/Legends|alien]], primitive, ancient, and obscure forms of [[Writing/Legends|writing system]], usually carved on hard surfaces. Their usage seems to have been in ritualistic, monumental, pictographic and decorative context. These uses and traits distinguished them from the more modern and casual alphabetic systems.

The ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] used a hieroglyphic script, which was evolved to [[High Sith]] via simplification, eventually resulting to [[Common Sith]] and the [[Massassi (alphabet)|Massassi alphabets]].<ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

Spires covered with alien hieroglyphics were seen among the monuments and artifacts in the [[Valley of the Jedi]] on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], a necropolis made after the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="Dark forces">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref><ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

[[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassans]] [[Sanyassan hieroglyphs|used hieroglyphs]], considered crude and uninterpretable by [[Pfilbee Jhorn]].<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> The [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellians]] also used [[Dressellian hieroglyphs|primitive hieroglyphs]], until they adopted the [[Botha]] alphabet.<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref> The [[Abyssin (language)|Abyssin]] [[Abyssin (written language)|written language]] was also composed of hieroglyphs.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
